enchantments.tooltip: Wisdom +14: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +14 Enhancement bonus to Wisdom.
Healing Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming positive energy healing by +15 (Exceptional bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Quality Devotion +38: Passive: +38 Quality bonus to Positive (Healing) Spell Power.
Deific Focus III: On Spell Cast: +1 Sacred bonus to DC of that school for five seconds. Stacks up to III times. Casting a spell from another school clears all stacks of this effect.
Mythic Head Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
